$comment: Chaldean compound numbers 10 to 52 that have their own reading; the others read like an earlier one (rules spec 3.5). Draft text by Claude, based on classical Chaldean meanings, for numerologist review.

blocks.compound.10: 10, the Wheel of Fortune: rise and fall, and the ability to make plans come true. Good name and honour follow when it is used for good.
blocks.compound.11: 11, the Clenched Hand: hidden trials and the need for care with trust. Faith and vigilance turn its tests into strength.
blocks.compound.12: 12, the Sacrifice: giving more than one receives. Its lesson is to serve without being used, and to say no when needed.
blocks.compound.13: 13, Regeneration: change, upheaval and new beginnings. Hard work and acceptance of change bring renewal.
blocks.compound.14: 14, Movement: travel, trade and changing fortunes through others. Caution in partnerships and moderation bring success.
blocks.compound.15: 15, the Magician: charm, eloquence and a gift for attracting help and money. Use its magnetism kindly.
blocks.compound.16: 16, the Shattered Citadel: sudden reversals of plans. Humility and careful foresight soften its lessons.
blocks.compound.17: 17, the Star of the Magi: rising above difficulty, peace and a lasting name. One of the most fortunate compounds.
blocks.compound.18: 18, conflict between the material and the spiritual. Watchfulness and honesty guard against deception.
blocks.compound.19: 19, the Prince of Heaven: success, happiness and esteem. A highly fortunate compound.
blocks.compound.20: 20, the Awakening: new purpose and a call to action. Better for higher aims than for material gain alone.
blocks.compound.21: 21, the Crown of the Magi: honour, advancement and victory after long effort. A fortunate compound.
blocks.compound.22: 22, Submission and Caution: a good person misled by false judgement. Care in choices and advisers is needed.
blocks.compound.23: 23, the Royal Star of the Lion: help from superiors and success in plans. A very fortunate compound.
blocks.compound.24: 24, Love and Support: help from people in power and success in love and money. A fortunate compound.
blocks.compound.25: 25, Strength through Experience: success after trials, earned by observation and learning. Favourable for later life.
blocks.compound.26: 26, the Partnership Warning: loss through bad advice or partners. Choose associates carefully.
blocks.compound.27: 27, the Sceptre: authority, command and reward for intellect and creativity. A fortunate compound.
blocks.compound.28: 28, Trust and Contradiction: great promise with a risk of loss through trust in others. Plan for the future and guard what is built.
blocks.compound.29: 29, Grace under Pressure: trials, uncertainty and deception by others. Faith and steady effort carry one through.
blocks.compound.30: 30, Thoughtful Deduction: mental superiority and retrospection, chosen over material gain. Neither fortunate nor unfortunate; it depends on aim.
blocks.compound.31: 31, the Hermit: self-containment and solitude, with depth of thought. Fortunate for inner life more than worldly success.
blocks.compound.32: 32, Communication: magic in speech and the ability to sway people. Fortunate when one keeps to one's own judgement.
blocks.compound.37: 37, Love and Friendship: good partnerships, harmony and good fortune through others. A fortunate compound.
blocks.compound.43: 43, Upheaval and Revolution: struggle, change and opposition. Careful planning and patience are needed.
blocks.compound.51: 51, the Warrior: sudden advancement and success in leadership. Powerful, though it may attract rivals.
